blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines— Sen. Risa Hontiveros on Wednesday raised the possibility that former Bamban, Tarlac Mayor Alice Guo’s Pogo “networks” are still operating underground, citing the recent raids in Quezon City and Zamboanga Sibugay.
